answer: No agent joins the trusted set for free: each must post a refundable stake bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest its honest work over many epochs, so a clone fleet funds a separate bond and waits its own vesting voyage per fake and sybil cost scales linearly. A rising tide of throwaway identities earns near-zero weight, and no clever cipher of self-praise buys standing that only accrued history can forge.
